info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Meetings Meetings Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Meeting Cancellation API allows consumers to efficiently cancel scheduled meetings within the system. Designed for use by administrative staff and application integrators, this endpoint streamlines the management of meeting schedules by enabling the bulk cancellation of meetings. Users can specify the meetings to be canceled, ensuring that the process is both precise and efficient. This API is crucial for organizations looking to maintain an organized calendar and manage resources effectively, particularly in dynamic scheduling environments.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing meeting. Upon successful cancellation, the meeting will no longer be scheduled. Ensure that you have the correct meeting ID before proceeding with the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed to cancel a meeting. The payload must include the necessary identifiers to determine which meeting is to be canceled.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: Request body for cancelling a meeting operation in JSON format.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_201.title: Cancel Meeting Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancel operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier associated with the cancel request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the cancel operation.

state.description: The current state of the meeting after the cancel operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancel request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_201.description: This object represents the response received after canceling a meeting.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: This object contains audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and debugging.
